remarks: This newly renovated and expanded modern colonial perfectly blends style, functionality, and luxury. The brand-new kitchen with exposed beams is a true showstopper, featuring high-end appliances, a spacious island, bar with wine fridge, and an oversized pantry with reclaimed wood door-ideal for both everyday living and entertaining. The adjacent sitting room with exposed brick floor and skylights is the perfect place to unwind. Every detail has been meticulously updated, from the all-new bathrooms to the refined lighting, flooring, and gleaming hardwoods throughout. The open floor plan is flooded with natural light, creating a warm and inviting ambiance. Highlights include a large dining room, a large family room with a vaulted ceiling and fireplace, and a first-floor primary suite complete with a spa-like bathroom and a generously sized walk-in closet. The second floor has three additional bedrooms with large walk-in closets and two full bathrooms and the laundry room. The lower level offers even more versatility, with a bright office, a sunny playroom/gym, and a large mudroom designed for practicality and organization. Step outside to an expansive deck with a fireplace, overlooking a flat, private yard-perfect for entertaining or simply relaxing. Conveniently located close to town, this exceptional home combines modern convenience with timeless elegance, offering a truly unparalleled living experience.
